title: Bolus and calc log doesn't get synced to AAPSClient from AAPS when using bolus calc occasionally (NSCv3)
body:
AAPS / AAPSClient 3.3.1.3
Build: 2a10ec79a6-2025.02.07
Nightscout-versjon: 15.0.2
NSClientv3

Occasionally the bolus and calc log from bolus calc doesn't get synced to AAPSClient. It's uploaded to NS. This time we used bolus calc on watch. Look for bolus calc entry and bolus 15:41. 

It's the third time happening since upgrading to 3.3.1.3. Attaching logs and screenshots.
Workaround is to clear database in AAPSClient and do a full sync.

Automatic time is set identical on all phones and time is seemingly in sync on the second.
